errata_records.symptom_verbatim: The USCI module may hang when a stop condition is received at 400 kHz at TA = 85°C.
errata_records.title_verbatim: USCI0 I2C Hang On Stop Condition
errata_records.workaround_verbatim: Use a lower bus frequency or toggle UCSWRST.

ti_advisory_details.symptom_verbatim: Bytes may be dropped when SCLK exceeds 8 MHz at 3.3 V.
